hero.title: Automate your business.
hero.description: A modern platform for comprehensive accounting automation, IFRS reporting, and business process management. Bring accounting, financial and management accounting, analytics, and key business processes together in a single ERP system to improve accounting transparency, management efficiency, and the quality of decision-making.

feature1.title: Dedicated 1C database creation
feature1.desc: Each user gets their own isolated 1C database, created automatically upon registration.

feature2.title: Real-time 1C integration
feature2.desc: Data synchronization between the web interface and 1C is ensured via REST API with high reliability.

feature3.title: User management
feature3.desc: Registration, authentication, and secure access to individual work environments using JWT.

feature4.title: Web access to 1C
feature4.desc: Convenient React interface allows working with your 1C database through a browser without installing additional software.

feature5.title: Business operations automation
feature5.desc: Automatic record creation, background process execution, and simplification of routine operations.

feature6.title: Analytics and monitoring
feature6.desc: View logs, track errors, and monitor the state of 1C databases for stable service operation.
